purpose: Evolve one creation through seven evidence-bearing parallel creative rounds, retain exactly two judged survivors after every round, bind real 3D/game observations into self-test, and optionally retain intermediate visual previews for machine, AI and user adjustment before final output without auto-accepting or auto-canonizing either finalist.

properties.criteria: optional existing specialist-tournament weighted judging criteria
properties.pool_size: 8..40 specialist profiles used by each round tournament
properties.preview_policy: optional {mode: off|internal|user-milestones|user-every-round, milestone_rounds, retain_artifacts, ai_review}; default keeps internal machine previews on and AI/user interruption off
properties.submissions: complete object keyed by every current round team_id
properties.judgements: complete independent existing tournament judgements keyed by team_id
properties.candidate: candidate or artifact body for deterministic self-test/preview; 3D artifacts may name preview_image_path in addition to asset/required_sockets/animation_expected, and playable games may name path/entrypoint/browser_executable/interaction_recipes/allow_synthetic_activation
properties.feedback: for a pending user checkpoint, exact object keyed by both retained candidate ids containing user preview observations, continue|adjust|hold decision, and optional requested_changes

contains: parallel context-specific creative-team packets from the existing specialist tournament
two exact evidence-bearing survivor outputs after every completed round
visual-thought and generic project verification adapters
real GLB structure/pose/skin/socket/animation observations when supported
real local headless-browser execution, screenshot bytes, runtime probes and optional bounded interaction/reset-recovery observations for playable browser games
intermediate preview checkpoints with digest-bound retained pixel/render artifacts when available
machine observation context always available when preview mode is active, AI review only when explicitly enabled, and user feedback gates only under user-selected preview modes
preview feedback propagated into the next round parent/creative-team context before another candidate is judged
explicit NOT_TESTED/HOLD state for unsupported evidence or preview surfaces
two retained final outputs with structural, functional, visual, experience, context, adversarial and polish evidence lanes

relationships: composes the existing specialist tournament instead of creating a second parallel-team ontology
uses the existing deterministic simulation and project-verification surfaces when the artifact kind is supported
reuses the existing pure-Python game-pose runtime for bounded GLB geometry/animation/skin/socket evidence instead of inventing a second 3D parser
reuses the existing offline design-browser observer for actual local browser execution, screenshot/runtime measurements and caller-authorized bounded interaction recipes
intermediate previews are retained under creation evidence space so a later machine/AI/user reviewer can inspect the exact bytes instead of relying on a prose claim
the default preview policy does not call AI or interrupt the user; AI review and user checkpoints are explicit user-controlled choices
user-every-round and user-milestones modes block further round advancement until preview feedback for both survivors is recorded
continue/adjust/hold preview decisions and requested changes are carried into the exact survivor parent context for the next creative round
creative outputs and semantic judgements remain externally supplied evidence rather than faked deterministic cognition
the best two complete judged outputs remain live after each round and become explicit parents for the next round
deep aftertouch is a final evidence-bearing creation pass rather than a decorative label after generation
finalists are retained but never automatically accepted, merged, canonized, or called perfect
limitations: creative-team packets do not imply that a team reasoned, built, rendered, played or tested until concrete executor evidence is supplied

GLB observation proves only the supported bounded file/pose/skin/socket/geometry facts; pixel review for 3D still requires a renderer-produced preview image until an explicit renderer executor is available
browser-game preview requires a caller-supplied local Chromium-compatible executable unless PATH discovery is explicitly enabled; synthetic activation is disabled unless explicitly authorized

a captured screenshot or render preview is real visual evidence but is never automatic aesthetic PASS; machine measurements can diagnose known facts while AI/human perceptual judgments remain separately sourced
AI preview review defaults off to preserve local/offline behavior and requires explicit preview_policy.ai_review=true
user checkpoint modes can stop the workflow for review, but off/internal modes never manufacture a user decision
bounded browser interaction is programmatic focus/synthetic activation on a temporary offline copy, not trusted user input or a complete playtest/usability study
independent tournament judgements remain evidence inputs and can be poor or biased; the chamber preserves their declared basis rather than treating scores as objective truth
seven rounds and two survivors remain fixed v0.3 policy to preserve the requested creative evolution shape
all-PASS final evidence does not prove perfection, universal aesthetic quality, semantic correctness outside tested claims, or human acceptance
persistent_state: Chamber state, round history, survivor lineage, preview policy, preview receipts and recorded feedback are explicit digest-bound caller-carried state; retained preview files live under creations/.aftertouch-previews and no hidden chat state is required.

truth.basis: Unsupported or unobserved evidence stays NOT_TESTED/HOLD; screenshot capture is separated from perceptual judgment and feedback records identify their reviewer.

agency.basis: The user controls whether previews are internal, milestone-interrupting, every-round, or off; AI review is opt-in; two finalists remain unaccepted and non-CANON automatically.

continuity.basis: Every retained preview has exact artifact/digest provenance and its review/requested changes are carried with the survivor into the next round instead of disappearing into hidden chat context.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The machine can inspect visual evidence and adjust before output, while explicit user checkpoint modes intentionally trade speed for review when the user wants it.
